items.title: Herbie Hancock interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 18, 1995
items.q: I had been a former member of Miles’ band... I was there for five and a half years after that... I learned so much from Miles that I would be a very different piano player had it not been for that experience in playing with that particular Miles Davis group

ctx.x: It’s still played today. And he was also responsible for introducing me to Miles Davis. So I owe a lot to Donald Byrd. I mean so much that I could never repay him for what he’s done for me.
Somebody has to give you that hand, don’t they?
